name: io.github.martusha89/discord-claude-full-mcp
title: Discord (Full)
description: Discord MCP server: messages, images, files, stickers, emoji reactions, and TTS voice notes.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal

environmentVariables.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ElevenLabs API key. Only needed for the send_voice_note tool

environmentVariables.name: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID
environmentVariables.description: ElevenLabs voice id used for voice notes. Required alongside the API key

environmentVariables.name: ELEVENLABS_MODEL_ID
environmentVariables.description: ElevenLabs model id. Defaults to eleven_turbo_v2_5

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_DEFAULT_GUILD_ID
environmentVariables.description: Server assumed when a tool call omits the server argument
